description: A31 + A32: the bootstrap pages that carry derived entities. New entity types travel only in `entities` as {entity, id, version, payload}; the v1 collections are present and empty on these pages. A client that does not know habit_progress or period_evaluation keeps them opaque under that name and still syncs (tolerant reader, invariant 13).
rules: habit_progress: one per habit; id is the habit id; version is the streak cache version
period_evaluation: only start_date within the last 400 days of the user's local today; version is the revision
the client stores both under their own entity names, exactly as a pull would
